Scope correction (skills seat, 2026-09-19), on the maintainer's objection: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` records IMPLEMENTED, verified capabilities only (all 264 items are `status: active`; there is no planned state), so a checklist item cannot be the sole test — reading it that way closes every capability-gap card under the North Star's definition line, and 「缺任何一样就不是这个应用」 makes those gaps requirements, not expansion.

The test is two-layered and the `Path:` line carries both:
1. Definition layer first: which item of 「做出来的是什么」 does the card's capability fall under? None ⇒ outside the North Star ⇒ close.
2. Ledger layer second: an existing checklist item would FAIL ⇒ defect, inherit the item's P; no item exists ⇒ capability GAP ⇒ keep — on the path ⇒ P0/P1, off it ⇒ p3 (rule 2's 「p3 或不做」 resolves to p3 here) — and the gap is the input to `checklist-author` (write the item into the ledger before scheduling).

So :362 becomes `Path: <定义项> | <清单项 id | 缺项> | P<路步> | none`, and the one-line rule reads: 定义项落不到 ⇒ 关;有清单项会 fail ⇒ 继承其 P;缺项 ⇒ 缺口保留(路上 P0/P1,否则 p3)并列入待补账本;⛔「有人在等」不是判据. Acceptance greps updated accordingly: 「定义项」 and 「缺项」 in SKILL.md ≥ 1 each (control 0). Byte budget as before (812 / 812 line-neutral). Dispatch waits for the maintainer's sweep rounds to settle the wording.
